subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: Should OpenClaw support Volcengine Lite UUID-style keys by selecting a different provider endpoint/route, or should setup/runtime report that this key is for an unsupported Volcengine surface?
rationale: Source inspection can show why the reported key passes setup and reaches runtime, but only a maintainer-approved Volcengine Lite contract check can decide whether OpenClaw should route it differently or fail with better diagnostics.

options.title: Probe and route Lite keys
options.body: Use a credentialed Lite contract check to identify the correct Volcengine endpoint or route and implement provider-owned handling if the API is supported.

options.title: Keep route and improve diagnostics
options.body: If Lite keys are not compatible with OpenClaw's supported Volcengine endpoints, keep the current runtime path and surface a setup/runtime error that names the unsupported key class.

options.title: Close as unsupported after proof
options.body: If provider documentation or live testing shows this Lite plan cannot support the requested model/API, close with the supported Volcengine setup path.

recommendation.title: Probe and route Lite keys
recommendation.body: Use a credentialed Lite contract check to identify the correct Volcengine endpoint or route and implement provider-owned handling if the API is supported.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the Volcengine provider manifest, auth alias, and provider setup surfaces where the decision would land.
